actual_scope: For the live #2954 class-C 6554 four-flat configuration, can a provably sound stabilizer subgroup quotient the six-dimensional V2 mask enumeration for one five-dimensional V1 orbit?
scope_change_reason: The task catalog has no card for the active #2954 route-B checker handoff. replay-runtime is the closest method card, but its original scope concerns selected-result replays. This changed investigation certifies a finite symmetry quotient for the separately pinned s4z direction catalog; it does not claim an end-to-end s4z speedup or a class-C row exclusion.
bottleneck_link: The #2954 route-B handoff identifies V2 pair enumeration as a major cost before four-flat closure. A sound stabilizer quotient can reduce candidate V2 masks while preserving the exact span predicate.
stop_rule: Stop after an exact group-action proof and a fully enumerated bounded V1/V2 mask orbit slice; do not infer any row kill, full-config pass, or kappa change without integrating and completing the s4z closure search.
evidence: The verifier pins the 18,100-row data88 catalog, confirms all 12 generators act linearly and invertibly on F2^9, checks each induced Off-support permutation and exact invertible Q^8 matrix witness on every listed line/plane direction, then exhaustively partitions the 776,806 unique six-flat root masks into 47,850 orbits under a five-generator subgroup fixing a canonical five-flat mask. This is one first-flat group orbit and a candidate-count result only; catalog completeness is inherited from the pinned source.
author: OpenAI Codex
ai_assistance: Prepared and verified by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance. No independent human proof review is claimed.
